verdict.rationale: Gitea supports automation in several ways: an API and webhooks for custom workflows (gitea-docs-4), an official CLI, tea (gitea-probe-4), and built-in GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15). It deploys as a single binary or on Docker/Kubernetes (gitea-comm-1, gitea-comm-6, gitea-docs-10), and push-to-create lets automation create repos without the UI (gitea-comm-10). missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive/token-based use of tea or the API in CI pipelines, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and hands-on corroboration of headless CLI automation.
